import itertools
from pysat.solvers import Glucose3

solver = Glucose3()

# Edges
edges = list(itertools.combinations(range(8), 2))
edge_to_var = {e: i+1 for i, e in enumerate(edges)}

# Constraints
for subset in itertools.combinations(range(8), 4):
    subset_edges = list(itertools.combinations(subset, 2))
    vars = [edge_to_var[e] for e in subset_edges]
    
    # Not all 0 (at least one 1)
    solver.add_clause(vars)
    
    # Not all 1 (at least one 0)
    solver.add_clause([-v for v in vars])

if solver.solve():
    model = solver.get_model()
    colors = [1 if v > 0 else 0 for v in model[:28]]
    print("SAT")
    print(colors)
else:
    print("UNSAT")
